topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I stepped outside, the morning air carrying a whisper of the oncoming day, and found the driveway emptily greeting me. My car, the faithful companion through every journey, had vanished. A note, caught in the gentle breeze, lay where it once stood. The city had taken it, a misunderstanding perhaps. But in this quiet moment, I felt no anger, only a serene resolve. I'll call them, sort this out, and bring my friend home. Until then, I'll enjoy the unexpected pause, the quiet of the morning, and the gentle promise of a new day.
